```{r}
motifs <- readRDS("/work/FAC/FBM/LLB/dgfeller/scrnaseq/agabrie4/supercellV2/SuperCellMultiomicsAnalyses/H13CORE_human_pfm.rds")

motif.metadata <- data.frame()
for (m in names(motifs)) {
  m.df <- data.frame(row.names =m,
                     "tf" = motifs[[m]]@tags$tf,
                     "family" = motifs[[m]]@tags$family,
                     "sub.family" = motifs[[m]]@tags$sub.family)
  motif.metadata <- rbind(motif.metadata,m.df)
}

motif.metadata$final_family <- motif.metadata$family
motif.metadata$final_family[motif.metadata$family == "Unannotated" & motif.metadata$sub.family == ""] <- motif.metadata$tf[motif.metadata$family == "Unannotated" & motif.metadata$sub.family == ""]
motif.metadata$final_family[motif.metadata$sub.family == "" & motif.metadata$sub.family != ""] <-  motif.metadata$family[motif.metadata$sub.family == "" & motif.metadata$sub.family != ""] 
```

```{r}


DefaultAssay(mono.mac) <- "chromvar"

motif.metadata <- motif.metadata[rownames(mono.mac),]

mean.family.tf <- aggregate(GetAssayData(mono.mac,layer = "data"),list(motif.metadata$final_family),mean)
rownames(mean.family.tf) <- mean.family.tf[,1]

mono.mac[["motif_family"]] <- CreateAssay5Object(data = mean.family.tf[,-1])


mono.mac.pseudobulk <- PseudobulkExpression(mono.mac,return.seurat = T,group.by = c("fine_cell_type","Sample"))

mono.mac.pseudobulk$fine_cell_type <- gsub(x = mono.mac.pseudobulk$fine_cell_type,
                                           pattern = "-",
                                           replacement = "_")
mono.mac.pseudobulk$fine_cell_type <- factor(mono.mac.pseudobulk$fine_cell_type , 
                                             levels =  c("Macro_GPNMB","Macro_SPP1","Macro_SELENOP",
                                                         "Macro_CXCL9","Macro_INPPL1",
                                                         "Mono_VCAN","Mono/Macro_prolif",
                                                         "MonoDC"))
Idents(mono.mac.pseudobulk) <- "fine_cell_type"

gc()
```

```{r}

library(ggrepel)
# max(markers.mono.macro.unique[markers.mono.macro.unique$cluster== "Macro_CXCL10",]$FDR)

deg <- markers.mono.macro[markers.mono.macro$cluster== "Macro_CXCL9" & markers.mono.macro$logCPM>4,]
top.down <- deg$gene[deg$logFC<0 & -log10(deg$FDR) >10]
deg$Signature <- "No"
deg$Signature[(deg$gene %in% mulder.sig.isg.momac|(deg$gene %in% barras.sig | deg$gene %in% top.down))] <- "In signatures"
deg$Signature[(deg$gene %in% mulder.sig.isg.momac|(deg$gene %in% barras.sig  | deg$gene %in% top.down)) & 
                (deg$FDR < 0.01 &abs(deg$logFC)>0.75)] <- "In signatures & highlighted"

deg$Selection <- "None"
deg$Selection[deg$gene %in% mulder.sig.isg.momac] <- "Ifn MonoMac"
deg$Selection[deg$gene %in% barras.sig] <- "Mac responders"
deg$Selection[deg$gene %in% top.down] <- "Top down-regulated"

deg$Selection[deg$gene %in% barras.sig & deg$gene %in% mulder.sig.isg.momac] <- "Ifn MonoMac & Mac responders"

deg$Signature <- factor(deg$Signature,rev(c("In signatures & highlighted","In signatures","No")))
deg$Selection <-  factor(deg$Selection,c("Mac responders"   ,"Ifn MonoMac","Ifn MonoMac & Mac responders","Top down-regulated", "None" ))
# deg$Signature[(deg$gene %in% mulder.sig.isg.momac] <- "sig"

# deg$signature[deg$gene %in% irf.neutro] <- "Irf_neutro"
deg$marker <- T
deg$marker[deg$FDR>0.05] <- F
p <- ggplot(deg,aes(x=logFC,y= -log10(FDR),alpha = Signature,color = Selection)) + geom_point() + theme_bw() +   
  geom_label_repel(data = subset(deg, ((Signature != "No" & -log10(deg$FDR) >10) &abs(logFC) >0.75)), 
                   aes(x=logFC,y= -log10(FDR), label = gene,color = Selection),
                   force = 50,max.overlaps = 15,size = 2.5,
                   min.segment.length =0) +
  scale_alpha_manual(values = c(0.2,0.5,1)) + 
  scale_color_manual(values = rev(c("black","darkgreen","red","blue","darkorange"))) + theme(legend.position = "bottom")  + guides(
    alpha="none",
    color = guide_legend(ncol = 2)) 
p
```

```{r}
pbmc <- readRDS("../../../output/pbmcCiteSeqAtlas/supMetacells_SCT_supStacas_lognorm/g20/seuratCombinedWNN.rds")
pbmc$cell_type <- as.vector(pbmc$celltype.l2)

anno.table <- unique(data.frame("guiding_label" = pbmc$celltype.l1.5,
                                "fine_label" = pbmc$cell_type))
anno.table$guiding_label <- factor(anno.table$guiding_label,
                                   levels =c("B","CD4 T","CD8 T","dnT","gdT","MAIT","NK","ILC","Mono","DC","Eryth","Platelet","HSPC"))
anno.table <- unique(anno.table)
anno.table <- anno.table %>% arrange(factor(guiding_label),fine_label) 
anno.table

pbmc$cell_type <- factor(pbmc$cell_type,levels = anno.table$fine_label)


pbmc$time <- stringr::str_split_fixed(pbmc$orig.ident,pattern = "_",2)[,2]
pbmc$donor <- stringr::str_split_fixed(pbmc$orig.ident,pattern = "_",2)[,1]
DimPlot(pbmc,group.by = "celltype.l1",reduction = "wnn.umap")
pbmc <- FindMultiModalNeighbors(pbmc,reduction.list = list("pca","apca"),dims.list = list(c(1:40),c(1:50)),prune.SNN = 0)
pbmc <- RunUMAP(pbmc, nn.name = "weighted.nn", reduction.name = "wnn.uma", reduction.key = "wnnUMAP_",min.dist = 0.2,return.model = T) # go with min.dist=0.2 in fig 4
DimPlot(pbmc,reduction = "wnn.umap",label = T,group.by = "celltype.l2")

DefaultAssay(pbmc) <- "RNA"


pbmc <- FindClusters(pbmc,graph.name = "wsnn",algorithm = 3)
pbmc$metacell_cluster <- pbmc$wsnn_res.0.8


names(color_celltype) <- unique(pbmc$cell_type)
color_celltype_final <- color_celltype
color_celltype_final[["CD14 Mono"]] <- color_celltype[["CD8 Naive"]]
color_celltype_final[["CD8 Naive"]] <- color_celltype[["CD14 Mono"]]
# color_celltype_final[["CD4 TCM"]] <- color_celltype[["T/NK Prolif."]]
# color_celltype_final[["T/NK Prolif."]] <- color_celltype[["CD4 TCM"]]
color_celltype_final[["Platelet"]] <- color_celltype[["cDC1"]]
color_celltype_final[["cDC1"]] <- color_celltype[["Platelet"]]
color_celltype_final.2 <- color_celltype_final

# names(color_celltype_final.2) <- c(names(color_celltype_final.2)[1:28],"CD14 Mono/Platelet","CD14 Mono ifn")
pbmc$refined_celltype <- as.vector(pbmc$cell_type)
pbmc$refined_celltype[pbmc$wsnn_res.0.8 == 16] <- "CD14 Mono Ifn"
color_celltype_final.2[["CD14 Mono Ifn"]] <- "#b20000" 
DimPlot(pbmc,reduction = "wnn.umap",label = T,group.by = "refined_celltype",cols = color_celltype_final.2)


pbmc$metacell_cluster <- plyr::mapvalues(pbmc$wsnn_res.0.8,from = c(0,6,16),
                                         to = c("CD14 Mono","CD16 Mono", "CD14 Mono Ifn"))

pbmc$metacell_cluster <- factor(pbmc$metacell_cluster,levels =c("CD14 Mono","CD16 Mono", "CD14 Mono Ifn"))
```

```{r fig.height=4,fig.width=3}
library(reshape2)
mono.pbmc <-  mono.pbmc[,mono.pbmc$metacell_cluster %in% c("CD14 Mono","CD16 Mono","CD14 Mono Ifn")]

typeCounts <- aggregate(mono.pbmc$size, by=list(clusters = mono.pbmc$metacell_cluster,sample = mono.pbmc$orig.ident), FUN=sum,drop = T)

typeCounts$clusters <- factor(typeCounts$clusters,levels = unique(typeCounts$clusters))

contingencyTable <- xtabs(x ~ clusters+sample,data = typeCounts)
colSums(contingencyTable)

freqMatrix <- apply(contingencyTable,1,FUN = function(x){x/colSums(contingencyTable)})

freqMatrix_df$donor = stringr::str_split_fixed(freqMatrix_df$sample,"_",2)[,1]
freqMatrix_df$time = stringr::str_split_fixed(freqMatrix_df$sample,"_",2)[,2]

ggplot(freqMatrix_df[freqMatrix_df$clusters == "CD14 Mono Ifn", ],aes(x = time,y=value,color=clusters,group = clusters)) + geom_point() + geom_line() + facet_wrap("~donor")
```

```{r}
source("../../fun_r/seurat2PB.R")
library(edgeR)
edgeR.obj <- Seurat2PB.custom(object = mono.pbmc, sample="orig.ident", 
                              assay = "RNA", cluster="metacell_cluster")
edgeR.obj$samples$cluster <- sapply(edgeR.obj$samples$cluster, function(i)gsub(x=i,pattern = " ",replacement = "_"))

summary(edgeR.obj$samples$lib.size)
table(edgeR.obj$samples$cluster)

edgeR.obj$samples$time <- sapply(edgeR.obj$samples$sample, function(i) unique(mono.pbmc$time[mono.pbmc$orig.ident == i]))
edgeR.obj$samples$donor <- sapply(edgeR.obj$samples$sample, function(i) unique(mono.pbmc$donor[mono.pbmc$orig.ident == i]))


keep.samples <- edgeR.obj$samples$lib.size > 4e4
table(keep.samples)
edgeR.obj <- edgeR.obj[, keep.samples]
table(edgeR.obj$samples$cluster)

keep.CPM <- rowSums(cpm(edgeR.obj) >= 10) >= (min(table(edgeR.obj$samples$cluster)* 0.7) )
table(keep.CPM)
keep.TotalCount <- (rowSums(edgeR.obj$counts) >= 10)
keep.genes <- keep.CPM & keep.TotalCount
table(keep.genes)

edgeR.obj <- edgeR.obj[keep.genes, , keep=FALSE]
edgeR.obj <- normLibSizes(edgeR.obj)

rna.genes <- rownames(edgeR.obj)
```

```{r}
cluster <- factor(edgeR.obj$samples$cluster,levels =c("CD14_Mono","CD16_Mono", "CD14_Mono_Ifn"))
color.mds <- c("#56B4E9","#E69F00" ,"#009E73")


names(color.mds)<- levels(cluster)
plotMDS(edgeR.obj, pch=16, col=color.mds[cluster], main="MDS", top = 5000, gene.selection="common",) #, top = 5000, gene.selection="common"
legend("bottomleft", legend=levels(cluster), pch=16, cex=0.8)

```

```{r}

sample <- factor(edgeR.obj$samples$sample)
time <- factor(edgeR.obj$samples$time)
donor <- factor(edgeR.obj$samples$donor)
design <- model.matrix(~ 0 +cluster*time + donor  ) 
# design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + cluster + time + donor) ??
# design <- model.matrix(~ 0 + cluster * time + donor) ??

# colnames(design)[1] <- "Int"
head(design)

edgeR.obj <- estimateDisp(edgeR.obj, design, robust=TRUE)
edgeR.obj$common.dispersion
gc()
plotBCV(edgeR.obj)

fit <- glmQLFit(edgeR.obj, design, robust=TRUE)
gc()
plotQLDisp(fit)


# Define contrasts for each cluster
colnames(design) <- make.names(colnames(design))

contrasts <- makeContrasts(
  CD14_Mono_vs_All = clusterCD14_Mono - (clusterCD16_Mono + clusterCD14_Mono_Ifn) / 2,
  CD16_Mono_vs_All = clusterCD16_Mono - (clusterCD14_Mono + clusterCD14_Mono_Ifn) / 2,
  CD14_Mono_Ifn_vs_All = clusterCD14_Mono_Ifn - (clusterCD14_Mono + clusterCD16_Mono) / 2,
  levels = design
)

# Test for Cluster1 markers
results <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrasts[,"CD14_Mono_Ifn_vs_All"])


# Extract significant markers for each cluster
res.all.genes <- topTags(results, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table
res <- res.all.genes[(res.all.genes$FDR < 0.05 & res.all.genes$logFC >0.25)&res.all.genes$logCPM>4,]
res
```

# Pariwise compariosno
```{r}

contrasts <- makeContrasts(
  CD14_Mono_Ifn_vs_CD14_Mono = clusterCD14_Mono_Ifn - clusterCD14_Mono,
  CD14_Mono_Ifn_vs_CD16_Mono = clusterCD14_Mono_Ifn - clusterCD16_Mono,
  levels = design
)

results_vs_CD14 <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrasts[,"CD14_Mono_Ifn_vs_CD14_Mono"])
results_vs_CD16 <- glmQLFTest(fit, contrast = contrasts[,"CD14_Mono_Ifn_vs_CD16_Mono"])


# Extract significant markers for each cluster
res_vs_CD14 <- topTags(results_vs_CD14, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table
res_vs_CD16 <- topTags(results_vs_CD16, n = Inf, sort.by = "PValue")$table
colnames(res_vs_CD14) <- paste0(colnames(res_vs_CD14) ,"_vs_CD14")
colnames(res_vs_CD16) <- paste0(colnames(res_vs_CD16) ,"_vs_CD16")
common.genes <- rownames(res_vs_CD14)[rownames(res_vs_CD14) %in% rownames(res_vs_CD16)]

res_pairwise  <- cbind(res_vs_CD14[common.genes,],res_vs_CD16[common.genes,])
res_pairwise <- res_pairwise[res_pairwise$logCPM_vs_CD14*res_pairwise$logCPM_vs_CD16 >0,]
res_pairwise$max_FDR <- apply(res_pairwise[,c("FDR_vs_CD14","FDR_vs_CD16")],MARGIN =1, FUN = max)
res_pairwise <- res_pairwise[order(res_pairwise$max_FDR,decreasing = F),]
res_pairwise <- res_pairwise[(res_pairwise$max_FDR< 0.05 & res_pairwise$logCPM_vs_CD14>4)&res_pairwise$logCPM_vs_CD16>4,]
res_pairwise
```



```{r}


anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = pbmc,
  query = pbmc.multiome.g10,
  k.filter = NA,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  reference.reduction = "spca",
  reference.neighbors = "spca.annoy.neighbors",
  dims = 1:50,
  # k.score = 15,
  features = VariableFeatures(pbmc[["integratedRNA"]])
)



pbmc.multiome.g10 <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  query = pbmc.multiome.g10,
  reference = pbmc,
  refdata = list(
    celltype = c("wsnn_res.0.8"),
    refined_cell_type = "refined_celltype",
    predicted_ADT = "ADT"),
  reference.reduction = "spca",
  transferdata.args = list(k.weight = 40),
  reduction.model = "wnn.uma"
)
```

```{r}


anchors <- FindTransferAnchors(
  reference = pbmc,
  query = pbmc.multiome.sc,
  k.filter = NA,
  normalization.method = "LogNormalize",
  reference.reduction = "spca",
  reference.neighbors = "spca.annoy.neighbors",
  dims = 1:50,
  # k.score = 15,
  features = VariableFeatures(pbmc[["integratedRNA"]])
)



pbmc.multiome.sc <- MapQuery(
  anchorset = anchors,
  query = pbmc.multiome.sc,
  reference = pbmc,
  refdata = list(
    celltype = "wsnn_res.0.8",
    predicted_ADT = "ADT"),
  reference.reduction = "spca",
  transferdata.args = list(k.weight = 40),
  reduction.model = "wnn.uma"
)
```

```{r fig.height=5,fig.width=10}
GetVerticalVln <- function(vln,keep.label = F,keep.x.title = T) {
  vln <-vln  + coord_flip() + 
    NoLegend()+
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0, hjust=1))
  if (!keep.label) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                       axis.text.y=element_blank())
  }
  
  if (!keep.x.title) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  }
  return(vln)
}

library(patchwork)
vln.rna.final <- lapply(vln.rna.splitted, FUN = GetVerticalVln)
vln.rna.final[[1]] <- GetVerticalVln(vln.rna.splitted[[1]],keep.label = T)

wrapped.vln.rna.final <- wrap_plots(vln.rna.final,ncol = length(vln.rna.final),axis_titles  = "collect")

wrapped.vln.rna.final
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(atlas.mc) <- "ATAC"
#genes <- c("S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19")
Idents(atlas.mc) <- "major_cell_type"

CoveragePlotTSS <- function(atlas.mc,genes,color = major_cell_type_color) {
  TSS <- GetTSSPositions(Annotation(atlas.mc))
  TSS <- TSS[TSS$gene_name%in% genes,]
  
  regions <- lapply(X = genes, function(X){
    TSSgene <- TSS[TSS$gene_name == X]
    region <- Extend(TSSgene,upstream = 500,downstream = 500)
    return(region)
  })
  
  
  
  
  p <- CoveragePlot(
    object = atlas.mc,
    region = regions,ncol = length(regions),
    peaks = FALSE,color = color,
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = color) 
  
  
  p$patches$plots[[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[1]]  & theme(
    # strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    # strip.background = element_blank(),
    # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
    #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[1]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = "")) 
  
  
  
  for (i in c(2:(length(TSS))-1)) {
    p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                                                         strip.background = element_blank(),
                                                         # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
                                                         plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
                                                         #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
    
    
  }
  
  p$patches$plots[[length(TSS)]] <- p$patches$plots[[length(TSS)]]   & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                                                                             strip.background = element_blank(),
                                                                             # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
                                                                             plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
                                                                             #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                                                                             # axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                                             axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                                             axis.ticks.x= element_blank()
                                                                             # axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  ) & 
    xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
  
  p$patches$plots[[length(TSS)]][[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[length(TSS)]][[1]] + scale_y_continuous(position = "right",name = "Normalized ATAC signal",
                                                                                                  sec.axis = sec_axis( transform =~.*10, name="Second Axis")) +
    theme(axis.title.y.left  = element_blank(),
          axis.ticks.y.left = element_blank())
  
  p$patches$plots[[length(TSS)]][[2]] <- p$patches$plots[[length(TSS)]][[2]] + theme(axis.title.y  = element_blank())
  
  
  
  
  return(p)
}


p <- CoveragePlotTSS(atlas.mc = atlas.mc,genes = genes)


p
```

```{r fig.height=3.5,fig.width=5}
smp.kept.t <- names(which(count.smp.t>0))

count.smp.myelo <- colSums(table(sc.anno.myelo$major_cell_type,sc.anno.myelo$Sample))
smp.kept.myelo <- names(which(count.smp.myelo.T>0))
smp.kept <- intersect(smp.kept.myelo,smp.kept.t)

fine.momacdc.smp <- sc.anno[sc.anno$major_cell_type %in% c('Mono/Macro',"DC") & sc.anno$Sample %in% smp.kept,] %>% 
  group_by(fine_cell_type, Sample,.drop = FALSE) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  mutate(perc = count/sum(count))

fine.momacdc.smp

myelo.type <- "Macro_CXCL10"


fine.tnk.smp <- sc.anno[sc.anno$major_cell_type %in% c("T","NK")& sc.anno$Sample %in% smp.kept,] %>% 
  group_by(fine_cell_type, Sample,.drop = FALSE) %>% 
  summarise(count = n()) %>% 
  mutate(perc = count/sum(count))

fine.tnk.smp


fine.tnk.momacdc.combined <- rbind(fine.momacdc.smp,fine.tnk.smp)
fine.tnk.momacdc.combined


casted.perc <- acast(fine.tnk.momacdc.combined,Sample~fine_cell_type)
casted.perc[is.na(casted.perc)] <- 0



order.ct <- hclust(dist(t(casted.perc)))

cor.mtx <- Hmisc::rcorr(casted.perc)

cor.mtx.sig <- cor.mtx$r


corrplot::corrplot(cor.mtx.sig[unique(fine.tnk.smp$fine_cell_type),
                               unique(fine.momacdc.smp$fine_cell_type)])


tl.col <- rep("black",length(colnames(casted.perc)))
names(tl.col) <- colnames(casted.perc)


sig.level <-  0.05/(length(unique(fine.tnk.smp$fine_cell_type))*length(unique(fine.momacdc.smp$fine_cell_type))) # bonferonni corr
sig.level

pdf("fig5I.pdf",height=3.5,width=5)
corrplot::corrplot(cor.mtx$r[unique(fine.tnk.smp$fine_cell_type),
                             unique(fine.momacdc.smp$fine_cell_type)],
                   p.mat = cor.mtx$p[unique(fine.tnk.smp$fine_cell_type),
                                     unique(fine.momacdc.smp$fine_cell_type)],
                   tl.srt = 45,is.corr = F,tl.cex	=1,
                   mar = c(0, 0, 1, 0),cl.ratio	=0.3,
                   sig.level = sig.level
                   , insig='blank',order = "hclust",tl.col = "black")

dev.off()
```

# Multimodal markers of macrophages
```{r fig.height=10,fig.width=15}
remove(atlas.mc)
DefaultAssay(mac)
mac[["ATAC"]]@motifs@meta.data
motifs <- readRDS("/work/FAC/FBM/LLB/dgfeller/scrnaseq/agabrie4/supercellV2/SuperCellMultiomicsAnalyses/H13CORE_human_pfm.rds")

motif.metadata <- data.frame()
for (m in names(motifs)) {
  m.df <- data.frame(row.names =m,
                     "tf" = motifs[[m]]@tags$tf,
                     "family" = motifs[[m]]@tags$family,
                     "sub.family" = motifs[[m]]@tags$sub.family)
  motif.metadata <- rbind(motif.metadata,m.df)
}

motif.metadata$final_family <- motif.metadata$family
motif.metadata$final_family[motif.metadata$family == "Unannotated" & motif.metadata$sub.family == ""] <- motif.metadata$tf[motif.metadata$family == "Unannotated" & motif.metadata$sub.family == ""]
motif.metadata$final_family[motif.metadata$sub.family == "" & motif.metadata$sub.family != ""] <-  motif.metadata$family[motif.metadata$sub.family == "" & motif.metadata$sub.family != ""] 



source("../fun_r/FindMultimodalMarkers.R")


conversion <-  motif.metadata$tf 
names(conversion) <-rownames(motif.metadata)


tf.markers <- FindMultimodalMarkers.SuperCell(mac,group.by = 'fine_cell_type',assay1 = "RNA",assay2 = "chromvar",
                                              padj.cutoff = 0.001, base = 2, only.pos = T, return.thresh = 1,conversion = conversion,
                                              min.pct1 = 0.25,min.pct2 = 0,
                                              logfc.threshold1 = 0.5, logfc.threshold2 = 0.5)

tf.markers.multi <- tf.markers$MultimodalMarkers
tf.markers.multi$max_padj <- apply(X = tf.markers.multi[,c("RNA.p_val_adj","chromvar.p_val_adj")],MARGIN = 1,FUN = max)

tf.markers.multi$family <- plyr::mapvalues(x = tf.markers.multi$chromvar.gene,
                                           from = rownames(motif.metadata),
                                           to = motif.metadata$final_family,warn_missing = F)


select.tfs <- tf.markers.multi %>%
  group_by(family) %>%
  slice_max(abs(mean.rpb),n = 1) %>%
  arrange(factor(RNA.cluster, levels =  c("Macro_GPNMB","Macro_SPP1","Macro_C3","Macro_CXCL10","Macro_SELENOP","Macro_HGF")),
          -abs(mean.rpb)) %>% group_by(family) 

select.tfs

# select.tfs <- select.tfs[abs(select.tfs$mean.rpb)>0.1,]

select.tfs[ ,c("RNA.cluster","chromvar.gene","RNA.gene","feature","family","max_padj","mean.rpb")]
```

TF marker on RNA expression
```{r}
tf.markers <- macro.differential.exp[(macro.differential.exp$gene %in% motif.metadata$tf &
                                        macro.differential.exp$avg_log2FC > 0.5) & macro.differential.exp$pct.1>0.25,]
tf.markers$gene_cluster <- paste0(tf.markers$gene,"_",tf.markers$cluster)
tf.markers
```


TF marker on both RNA expression and motif accessibility

```{r}
macro.differential.activities$gene_cluster <- paste0(macro.differential.activities$gene_name,"_",macro.differential.activities$cluster)


multimodal.markers <- intersect(macro.differential.activities$gene_cluster,
                                tf.markers$gene_cluster)

multimodal.markers
multimodal.markers.genes <- stringr::str_split_fixed(multimodal.markers,pattern = "_", n = 3)[,1]
multimodal.markers.genes
```

## building the final table for multimodal TF markers
```{r}
macro.differential.activities.common <- macro.differential.activities[macro.differential.activities$gene_cluster %in% multimodal.markers,]
colnames(macro.differential.activities.common) <- paste0("chromvar_",colnames(macro.differential.activities.common))
rownames(macro.differential.activities.common) <- macro.differential.activities.common$chromvar_gene_cluster

tf.markers.common <- tf.markers[tf.markers$gene_cluster %in% multimodal.markers,]

colnames(tf.markers.common) <-  paste0("rna_",colnames(tf.markers.common))
rownames(tf.markers.common) <- tf.markers.common$rna_gene_cluster


multimodal.markers.res <- cbind(macro.differential.activities.common,
                                tf.markers.common[rownames(macro.differential.activities.common),]
)
multimodal.markers.res
# multimodal.markers.res <- multimodal.markers.res[multimodal.markers.res$rna_gene %in% unlist(tf.names),]

multimodal.markers.res$family_motif <- plyr::mapvalues(multimodal.markers.res$chromvar_gene,
                                                       from = rownames(motif.metadata),
                                                       to = motif.metadata$family,warn_missing = F)

```


# keep on marker for each family with a multimodal tf marker

```{r}
select.multimodal.markers.res <-  multimodal.markers.res %>%
  group_by(family_motif) %>%
  slice_min(rna_p_val_adj) %>%
  arrange(factor(rna_cluster, levels =  c("Macro_GPNMB","Macro_SPP1","Macro_C3","Macro_CXCL10","Macro_SELENOP","Macro_HGF")))

dim(select.multimodal.markers.res)

select.multimodal.markers.res
```

```{r}
mtx.final <- cor.mtx.sig[unique(fine.tnk.smp$fine_cell_type),
                         unique(fine.momacdc.smp$fine_cell_type)]


cor_indices <- which(!is.na(mtx.final), arr.ind = TRUE)

cor_values <- na.omit(as.vector(mtx.final))

cor_ranks <- rank(-cor_values)
# Combine the correlation values, ranks, and indices
ranked_correlations_with_indices <- data.frame(
  rowname = rownames(mtx.final)[cor_indices[, 1]],
  colname = colnames(mtx.final)[cor_indices[, 2]],
  correlation = cor_values,
  rank = cor_ranks
)

# View the result
ranked_correlations_with_indices[order(ranked_correlations_with_indices$rank),]
```

```{r}
Idents(atlas.mc) <- "major_cell_type"
T.myelo.markers <- FindMarkers.SuperCell(atlas.mc,ident.1 = "T",ident.2 = c("Mono/Macro","DC"),test.use = "survey_weighted_t",min.pct = 0.5,logfc.threshold = 1)
T.myelo.markers <- T.myelo.markers[T.myelo.markers$p_val_adj< 0.05,]
T.myelo.markers.order <- T.myelo.markers[order(abs(T.myelo.markers$avg_log2FC),decreasing = T),]

T.myelo.markers.order$cluster <- "T"
T.myelo.markers.order$cluster[sign(T.myelo.markers.order$avg_log2FC) < 0] <- "Myelo"
T.myelo.markers.order$gene <- rownames(T.myelo.markers.order)
T.myelo.markers.order[c("MSR1","SKAP1"),]
T.myelo.markers.top <- T.myelo.markers.order %>%
  group_by(cluster) %>%
  slice_head(n = 50) %>%
  ungroup()
rownames(T.myelo.markers.top) <- T.myelo.markers.top$gene

T.myelo.markers.top
T.myelo.markers.top[c("MSR1","SKAP1"),]
myelo.markers <- T.myelo.markers.top[T.myelo.markers.top$cluster == "Myelo","gene"]  
t.markers <- T.myelo.markers.top[T.myelo.markers.top$cluster == "T","gene"]


atlas.mc <- AddModuleScore(atlas.mc,features = list("Myelo" = myelo.markers$gene,
                                                    "T" = t.markers$gene)
                           ,name = c("Myelo","T"))


data <- FeatureScatter.SuperCell(atlas.mc[,atlas.mc$major_cell_type %in% c("T","DC","Mono/Macro","T/Myelo_doublets")],feature1 = "T2",feature2 = "Myelo1",cols = major_cell_type_color)$data
data$doublet <- F
data$doublet[grepl(x = data$colors, pattern = "doublet" )] <- T

scatter.sig.t.myelo.mc <-  ggplot(data,aes(x=T2,y=Myelo1,color = colors, alpha = doublet,size = size)) +  geom_point() + theme_classic() + 
  scale_color_manual(values = major_cell_type_color) + 
  xlab("Top T marker signature") +
  ylab("Top Myelo marker signature")
scatter.sig.t.myelo.mc
```

```{r}
  group_by(cluster) %>%
```

```{r fig.height=5,fig.width=10}
GetVerticalVln <- function(vln,keep.label = F,keep.x.title = T) {
  vln <-vln  + coord_flip() + 
    NoLegend()+
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0, hjust=1))
  if (!keep.label) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                       axis.text.y=element_blank())
  }
  
  if (!keep.x.title) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  }
  return(vln)
}

library(patchwork)
vln.rna.final <- lapply(vln.rna.splitted, FUN = GetVerticalVln)
vln.rna.final[[1]] <- GetVerticalVln(vln.rna.splitted[[1]],keep.label = T)

wrapped.vln.rna.final <- wrap_plots(vln.rna.final,ncol = length(vln.rna.final),axis_titles  = "collect")
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(atlas.mc) <- "ATAC"
#genes <- c("S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19")
Idents(atlas.mc) <- "major_cell_type"

CoveragePlotTSS <- function(atlas.mc,genes,color = major_cell_type_color) {
  TSS <- GetTSSPositions(Annotation(atlas.mc))
  TSS <- TSS[TSS$gene_name%in% genes,]
  
  regions <- lapply(X = genes, function(X){
    TSSgene <- TSS[TSS$gene_name == X]
    region <- Extend(TSSgene,upstream = 500,downstream = 500)
    return(region)
  })
  
  
  
  
  p <- CoveragePlot(
    object = atlas.mc,
    region = regions,ncol = length(regions),
    peaks = FALSE,color = color,
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = color) 
  
  
  p$patches$plots[[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[1]]  & theme(
    # strip.placement = "outside",strip.clip="off",
    strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
    #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[1]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = "")) 
  
  for (i in c(2:(length(TSS)))) {
    p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                                                         strip.background = element_blank(),
                                                         # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
                                                         plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
                                                         #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
    
    
  }
  
  return(p)
}


p <- CoveragePlotTSS(atlas.mc = atlas.mc,genes = genes)
```

```{r}
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = color) 
  
  
  p$patches$plots[[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[1]]  & theme(
    # strip.placement = "outside",strip.clip="off",

    strip.background = element_blank(),

    # axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[1]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = "")) 
  
  for (i in c(2:(length(TSS)))) {
    p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                                                         strip.background = element_blank(),
                                                         # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
                                                         plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
                                                         #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
    
    
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r fig.height=5,fig.width=10}
GetVerticalVln <- function(vln,keep.label = F,keep.x.title = T) {
  vln <-vln  + coord_flip() + 
    NoLegend()+
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0, hjust=1))
  if (!keep.label) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                       axis.text.y=element_blank())
  }
  
  if (!keep.x.title) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  }
  return(vln)
}

library(patchwork)
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(atlas.mc) <- "ATAC"
#genes <- c("S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19")
Idents(atlas.mc) <- "major_cell_type"

CoveragePlotTSS <- function(atlas.mc,genes,color = major_cell_type_color) {
  TSS <- GetTSSPositions(Annotation(atlas.mc))
  TSS <- TSS[TSS$gene_name%in% genes,]
  
  regions <- lapply(X = genes, function(X){
    TSSgene <- TSS[TSS$gene_name == X]
    region <- Extend(TSSgene,upstream = 500,downstream = 500)
    return(region)
  })
  
  
  
  
  p <- CoveragePlot(
    object = atlas.mc,
    region = regions,ncol = length(regions),
    peaks = FALSE,color = color,
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = color) 
  
  
  p$patches$plots[[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[1]]  & theme(
    # strip.placement = "outside",strip.clip="off",
    strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
    #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[1]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = "")) 
  
  for (i in c(2:(length(TSS)))) {
    p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                                                         strip.background = element_blank(),
                                                         # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
                                                         plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
                                                         #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
    
    
  }
  
  return(p)
}


p <- CoveragePlotTSS(atlas.mc = atlas.mc,genes = genes)
```

```{r}
                                                         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
    
    
  }
  
  return(p)
}
```

```{r fig.height=5,fig.width=10}
GetVerticalVln <- function(vln,keep.label = F,keep.x.title = T) {
  vln <-vln  + coord_flip() + 
    NoLegend()+
    theme(axis.title.y = element_blank(),
          axis.text.x=element_text(angle=0, hjust=1))
  if (!keep.label) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.ticks.y = element_blank(),
                       axis.text.y=element_blank())
  }
  
  if (!keep.x.title) {
    vln <- vln + theme(axis.title.x = element_blank())
  }
  return(vln)
}

library(patchwork)
vln.rna.final <- lapply(vln.rna.splitted, FUN = GetVerticalVln)
vln.rna.final[[1]] <- GetVerticalVln(vln.rna.splitted[[1]],keep.label = T)

wrapped.vln.rna.final <- wrap_plots(vln.rna.final,ncol = length(vln.rna.final),axis_titles  = "collect")
```

```{r}
DefaultAssay(atlas.mc) <- "ATAC"
#genes <- c("S100a9","C1qa","Cd3e","Cd19")
Idents(atlas.mc) <- "major_cell_type"

CoveragePlotTSS <- function(atlas.mc,genes,color = major_cell_type_color) {
  TSS <- GetTSSPositions(Annotation(atlas.mc))
  TSS <- TSS[TSS$gene_name%in% genes,]
  
  regions <- lapply(X = genes, function(X){
    TSSgene <- TSS[TSS$gene_name == X]
    region <- Extend(TSSgene,upstream = 500,downstream = 500)
    return(region)
  })
  
  
  
  
  p <- CoveragePlot(
    object = atlas.mc,
    region = regions,ncol = length(regions),
    peaks = FALSE,color = color,
  ) & scale_fill_manual(values = color) 
  
  
  p$patches$plots[[1]] <- p$patches$plots[[1]]  & theme(
    # strip.placement = "outside",strip.clip="off",
    strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
    strip.background = element_blank(),
    # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
    plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
    #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
    # axis.title.y = element_blank(),
    axis.text.x = element_blank(),
    axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
    # axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
  )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[1]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = "")) 
  
  for (i in c(2:(length(TSS)))) {
    p$patches$plots[[i]] <- p$patches$plots[[i]] & theme(strip.text.y.left = element_blank(),
                                                         strip.background = element_blank(),
                                                         # panel.background = element_rect(fill = NA,  color = "black"),
                                                         plot.margin = margin(l = 0,r=0,unit = "pt"),
                                                         #axis.line.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.title.y = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.text.x = element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.x= element_blank(),
                                                         axis.ticks.y = element_blank()
    )& xlab(gsub(x=p$patches$plots[[i]]$labels$x,pattern = " position \\(bp\\)",replacement = ""))
    
    
  }
  
  return(p)
}


p <- CoveragePlotTSS(atlas.mc = atlas.mc,genes = genes)
```
